messages:
elaine: Quick sync — we have 3 migration-guide PRs ready for review but the docs preview has been flaky. Need two reviewers assigned and a short pre-merge checklist. Can volunteers pick one? https://deploy.preview/redwood/mig-PRs

mike: I can take one (PR #841). Will run the preview locally and check linkcheck failures.

sara: I can take PR #842. Tagging @tony for final approval on the API surface change in that PR.

docs-bot: Preview build created for PR #841 — https://preview.build/841 — status: failed (linkcheck). See log: `ERROR: 404 for ./old-path/index.md`

tony: Re: API change in #842 — looks small (query param rename). I'm okay to approve after a quick smoke test. @jen any bandwidth for merge window today?

jen: I have ~30m after stand. Can do final pass for #842. For #843 (examples + SDK snippet updates) we need an SDK sanity check.

alex: I can do the SDK snippet check for #843. Quick note: make sure examples use the new client import `from redwood import Client` and not the legacy alias.

mike: I reproduced the linkcheck locally — it's a relative-frontmatter path in `docs/migration/2026-03-20.md`. Pushing a quick fix branch now: `fix/link-path-841`.

ci-bot: Linkcheck rerun queued for PR #841 — job 1123 — estimated 3m.

elaine: Proposed pre-merge checklist: 1) preview build green, 2) snippet tests pass, 3) at least one reviewer sign-off + approver if API changes, 4) changelog entry updated, 5) confirm redirects/backfills if pages removed. Anything missing?

sara: Add 'backfill redirects' explicitly — good catch. Also add 'update internal cross-links' if we rename headings/paths.

tony: Add 'verify telemetry naming' if this PR touches analytics/metric names so we don't break dashboards.

jen: +1 to checklist. Also confirm `make snippet-test` passes in CI for examples dir. I can run it before approving.

ci-bot: Linkcheck passed for PR #841 — job 1123 — status: success.

elaine: Sweet. Assignments then: mike -> #841, jen -> #842, alex -> #843. I'll aim for a merge window at 16:30 PT unless a canary merge is needed earlier.

mike: Will squash & merge #841 after green and update changelog.

alex: Ran snippet tests locally for #843, found one formatting nit (trailing whitespace). Pushing `docs/snippet-fix-843`.

jen: Reviewed #842, left one comment then approved.

elaine: Awesome, thanks all :tada: I'll post a quick note in release-war-room and mark the checklist in the PR templates before merge. If anything blocks, ping me in here or DM.

mike: Noted — pinging once merged.

alex: Will follow up if the snippet formatter flags anything else.

jen: Ready to merge from my side after the small nits are addressed.

elaine: Closing loop — if CI stays green we'll do the 16:30 PT merge window. I'll update the PRs and the release channel at 16:15 PT. Thanks everyone! :shipit:
